LanguageData.Homestead_GizmoRenameDesc: Give this house a custom name.
LanguageData.Homestead_GizmoAddYardDesc: Paint outdoor cells (a garden, porch or yard) that belong to this house.
LanguageData.Homestead_GizmoRemoveYardDesc: Remove painted yard cells from this house.
LanguageData.Homestead_GizmoAssignDesc: Assign the colonists who live in this house. Assigning a pawn automatically moves in their partner and children; you can add or remove anyone manually.
LanguageData.Homestead_GizmoExpandDoorsDesc: When enabled, the house includes rooms connected to the marker's room through doors. When disabled, only the marker's own room counts.
LanguageData.Homestead_GizmoOuterDoorDesc: Mark this as a front/back door. House claiming never crosses an outer door, so rooms beyond it stay unclaimed - use it to fence a house off from shared corridors or neighbouring dwellings.
LanguageData.Homestead_InspectOuterDoor: Outer door: house claiming stops here.
LanguageData.Homestead_InspectNoOwners: No owners assigned - select 'Set owner' to move a family in.
LanguageData.Homestead_InspectOutdoors: Marker is outdoors - place it inside a roofed, enclosed room.
LanguageData.Homestead_LetterMergeText: {0} and {1} are a couple, but they live in separate houses. Consider assigning them to the same house marker so they can share a home.
LanguageData.Homestead_SettingsHomelessDesc: Once the colony is established (a house exists, or a year has passed), colonists without a house get a mood debuff that worsens over time.
LanguageData.Homestead_SettingsGuestsDesc: Colonists occasionally spend recreation time visiting the home of a friend, giving both a mood bonus.
LanguageData.Homestead_SettingsAvoidanceDesc: Colonists won't idly wander into, clean, haul from, or use recreation buildings inside someone else's house. Emergencies (firefighting, rescue, doctoring, drafted orders, forced jobs) are unaffected.
LanguageData.Homestead_SettingsReplaceBedroomDesc: Housed pawns judge their whole house instead of getting the vanilla 'slept in bedroom/barracks' thoughts. Pawns without a house keep vanilla behaviour.
LanguageData.Homestead_SettingsMoodScaleDesc: Multiplies the mood effect of every Homestead thought.
LanguageData.Homestead_SettingsClaimDepthDesc: How many doors deep a house extends from the marker's room.
LanguageData.Homestead_SettingsMaxRoomCellsDesc: Rooms larger than this are considered communal (dining halls, warehouses) and are never claimed as part of a house.
